title: H5239 (126th General Assembly): Firearms on campus

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2026-02-24; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess126_2025-2026/prever/5239_20260224.htm (LegiScan doc 3373893))
provenance.note: Introduced text of 2026-02-24; no passage vote. Struck: 'or' and 'armed forces'; added 'a duly authorized', 'Armed Forces of the United States while acting within the scope of his official duties' and 'a' before 'student'.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (Section 16-23-420(D)): This section does not apply to a guard, law enforcement officer, a duly authorized member of the Armed Forces of the United States while acting within the scope of his official duties, or a student of military science. A married student residing in an apartment provided by the private or public school whose presence with a firearm in or around a particular building is authorized by persons legally responsible for the security of the buildings is also exempted from the provisions of this section.
